name: OW5b-S1-boarded-from-the-helm
note: The raid boards a traveller still at the helm: the next frame's sail stands them back at their boat's helm, on no deck.

name: OW5b-S1-refused-lets-go
old: if (warmAshesRaidRefusal()) return;   // the mod's own refusals
note: A raid the mod refuses still lets go of the helm: the traveller stops sailing for a raider that sheers off.

name: OW5b-S2-window-ashore
old:
if (playerEntity.health <= 0 || modes?.deathUp?.() || gamePaused() || worldMoveBusy()) return;
    const at = warmAshesOn()
new:
if (playerEntity.health <= 0 || modes?.deathUp?.() || worldMoveBusy()) return;
    const at = !gamePaused() && warmAshesOn()
note: A window reads as ashore: every chase given up, the raider spent for its life.

name: OW5b-S6-mid-move-chase
old:
if (playerEntity.health <= 0 || modes?.deathUp?.() || gamePaused() || worldMoveBusy()) return;
    const at = warmAshesOn()
new:
if (playerEntity.health <= 0 || modes?.deathUp?.() || gamePaused()) return;
    const at = warmAshesOn()
note: A chase steps against the feet read mid-move, a kilometre from where they land.

name: OW5b-S2-deck-ashore
note: Off the helm on one's own deck at sea reads as ashore: a raider closing is spent.

name: OW5b-S2-passenger-quarry
note: A passenger aboard another's boat is chased and raided - and set back in the water the boat sailed on from.

name: OW5b-S3-chaser-unseen
note: A chase whose raider's life turned over is out of the list: unseen, it comes alongside all the same.

name: OW5b-S8-drawn-without-boats
note: Pirates are drawn on the map of a traveller with no boat to be at sea in.

name: OW5b-S5-born-off-the-map
old: if (!onBayOrEther(px, py) || maps.getClimateIndex(px, py) !== CLIMATES.Ocean) return false;
note: A raider born a pixel past the map's edge. RE-AIMED (ETHER-OW): the ground is the Bay's map or the Eltheric Ocean's box (onBayOrEther).

name: OW5b-S5-sails-off-the-map
note: Past the map's edge is the sea: a raider sails off the world. RE-AIMED (ETHER-OW): the ground's own law, onBayOrEther, at the floored pixel.

name: OW5b-S4-leg-by-its-end
note: A leg asks its end alone: it sails across a cape to the water beyond.

name: OW5b-S4-partial-leg-flips
old: const way = clear(h) ? h : clear(h + Math.PI) ? h + Math.PI : null;
new: const way = sea(x + Math.sin(h) * step * frac, z + Math.cos(h) * step * frac) ? h : h + Math.PI;
note: A part-sailed leg asks its own moving end: the moment it touches land the raider jumps the other way.
